items.title: Eddie Miller and Pete Fountain Interview, 1970-01-09
items.q: I knew Jack Delaney and Terry Andrews called up. I've known him for years

ctx.x: Yeah, he's there. I wanted to just mention, too, that, again, he doesn't expect any medals or any thanks, but for the beautiful contribution to the Gulf Coast victims of Hurricane Camille that he did so gracefully and wonderfully. And I've enjoyed your programs all the time, all the programs that you have. So I just wanted to mention that. I auditioned the radio. I was at Blue Room Cashier for five months at night, you know. And, of course, I knew Jack Delaney and Terry Andrews called up. I've known him for years…
